name: DARK SOULS II: Scholar of the First Sin

achievements.name: The Dark Soul
achievements.description: Earn all achievements

achievements.name: Self Recollection
achievements.description: Reclaim flesh and set out as an Undead

achievements.name: King's Ring
achievements.description: Acquire the King's Ring (defeat the boss in the Undead Crypt and take the item in the room behind).

achievements.name: Ancient Dragon
achievements.description: Acquire the Ashen Mist Heart - reach the Dragon Shrine through Aldia's Keep and speak to the Ancient Dragon.

achievements.name: The Heir
achievements.description: See the ending (complete the game).

achievements.name: Last Giant
achievements.description: Defeat the Last Giant in the Forest of Fallen Giants.

achievements.name: Sinner's Bonfire
achievements.description: Light the primal bonfire in Sinner's Rise (after defeating the Lost Sinner).

achievements.name: Iron Keep Bonfire
achievements.description: Light the primal bonfire in the Iron Keep (after defeating the Old Iron King).

achievements.name: Gulch Bonfire
achievements.description: Light the primal bonfire in the Black Gulch (after defeating the Rotten).

achievements.name: Brightstone Bonfire
achievements.description: Light the primal bonfire in Brightstone Cove Tseldora (after defeating Duke's Dear Freja).

achievements.name: Looking Glass Knight
achievements.description: Defeat the Looking Glass Knight in Drangleic Castle.

achievements.name: Vendrick
achievements.description: Defeat Vendrick (an optional boss in the Undead Crypt - collect Giant Souls first to weaken him).

achievements.name: Supreme Weapon
achievements.description: Reinforce a weapon to its limit

achievements.name: Gesture Maestro
achievements.description: Learn all gestures

achievements.name: Master of Sorcery
achievements.description: Learn all sorceries

achievements.name: Master of Miracles
achievements.description: Learn all miracles

achievements.name: Master of Pyromancy
achievements.description: Learn all pyromancies

achievements.name: Master of Hexes
achievements.description: Learn all hexes

achievements.name: Brilliant Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Heirs of the Sun covenant (examine the broken Sunlight shrine in Harvest Valley).

achievements.name: Protector Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Blue Sentinels covenant (defeat the Old Dragonslayer, then speak to Blue Sentinel Targray with a Token of Fidelity).

achievements.name: Sanguinary Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Brotherhood of Blood covenant (speak to Titchy Gren in Undead Purgatory with a Token of Spite).

achievements.name: Covenant of the Meek
achievements.description: Discover the Way of the Blue covenant (exhaust Crestfallen Saulden's dialogue in Majula).

achievements.name: Gnawing Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Rat King covenant (defeat the Royal Rat Vanguard or Royal Rat Authority and speak to the Rat King).

achievements.name: Clangorous Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Bell Keepers covenant (speak to the Bell Keeper's Dwarf at Belfry Luna or Belfry Sol).

achievements.name: Covenant of Ancients
achievements.description: Discover the Dragon Remnants covenant (obtain the Petrified Egg from the Dragon Shrine, then speak to Magerold of Lanafir in the Iron Keep while holding it).

achievements.name: Covenant of the Fittest
achievements.description: Discover the Champion's Covenant (examine Victor's Stone tablet on the cliff in Majula).

achievements.name: Abysmal Covenant
achievements.description: Discover the Pilgrims of Dark covenant (speak to Darkdiver Grandahl in the Shaded Ruins, the Black Gulch and Drangleic Castle).

achievements.name: Selfless Giver
achievements.description: Max-out devotion to covenant

achievements.name: Curious Map
achievements.description: Light all the flames on the Majula map (defeat eight bosses and obtain two key items, then speak to Cale).

achievements.name: Change of Clothes
achievements.description: Give Rosabeth of Melfia something to wear (free her with a Fragrant Branch of Yore and equip her with armour).

achievements.name: Gathering of Exiles
achievements.description: Increase Majula's population by getting seven specific NPCs to relocate there.

achievements.name: Moonlight Greatsword
achievements.description: Inherit Benhart of Jugo's equipment

achievements.name: Holder of the Fort
achievements.description: Inherit Captain Drummond's equipment (with the Ashen Mist Heart, defeat the Giant Lord in the Memory of Jeigh, then return to Drummond).

achievements.name: Lucatiel
achievements.description: Inherit Lucatiel of Mirrah's equipment (exhaust her dialogue at all three meeting spots and ensure she survives three boss fights, then meet her in Aldia's Keep).

achievements.name: Smith for Life
achievements.description: Inherit Steady Hand McDuff's equipment (free him, obtain the Dull Ember, and spend 14,000 souls on infusions with him).

achievements.name: Garrulous Miser
achievements.description: Inherit Laddersmith Gilligan's equipment (buy his ladder in Earthen Peak, defeat Mytha, then buy all three ladders in Majula and exhaust his dialogue).

achievements.name: Reflections on Disembodiment
achievements.description: Inherit the equipment of the head of Vengarl (find his helmet in the Shaded Woods clearing and speak to it repeatedly).

achievements.name: This is Dark Souls
achievements.description: Die for the first time
